overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（10 篇）、行为金融（1 篇）、绿色金融与可持续发展（1 篇）。方法上以实验方法、优化方法为主。来源分布：arXiv（12 篇）。

papers.title: FinRank: An Evidence-Grounded Benchmark for Financial Question Answering and Retrieval over SEC Filings
papers.abstract: Financial question answering is typically evaluated by answer correctness, yet in SEC filings a plausible and even numerically correct answer can be grounded in the wrong evidence. Similar facts and disclosures recur across sections of a filing, across reporting periods of the same firm, and across comparable firms. FinRank targets this provenance-sensitive retrieval problem by requiring systems to identify evidence for the intended entity, reporting period, and disclosure context. The benchmark contains 1185 manually authored question-answer records over the 10-K and 10-Q filings of 22 companies. Each record includes a reference answer, gold supporting passages, and hand-curated hard negatives drawn from confusable passages within filings, across reporting periods, and across comparable firms. FinRank evaluates passage retrieval, reranking, and hard-negative discrimination as separately measured tasks. Baseline results demonstrate the difficulty of this setting: among the evaluated systems, even a 7B instruction-tuned embedder reaches only 44.8% Recall@10 on the pooled evidence corpus; sub-billion-parameter encoders gain at most 3.5 points over BM25, a finance-adapted embedder trails BM25 by 9.7 points, and pairwise accuracy falls by 13.0-20.5 percentage points when random negatives are replaced with the curated hard negatives. FinRank provides an evidence-first benchmark for developing financial question answering systems that are not only accurate but also grounded in the correct disclosure.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】财务问答任务的评估通常基于答案的正确性，然而在证券交易委员会（SEC）的文件中，一个看似合理甚至数值上正确的答案也可能基于错误的证据。类似的事实和披露内容会出现在同一份文件的多个部分、同一公司的不同报告期间，以及同类公司之间。FinRank针对这一对来源信息敏感的检索问题，要求系统能够识别与目标实体、报告期间和披露背景相关的证据。该基准测试包含了来自22家公司10-K和10-Q年报的1185条人工编写的问题-答案对。每条记录都包含一个参考答案、用于验证正确性的示例段落，以及从文件中挑选出的、具有混淆性的段落中手工整理出的“硬否定”示例（即错误的答案）。FinRank将段落检索、重新排序以及硬否定判断这三个任务分别进行评估。基准测试结果揭示了这一问题的难度：在所有评估的系统中，即使使用了经过70亿参数训练的嵌入模型，在综合证据语料库上的召回率也只有44.8%；参数数量较少的编码器相比BM25模型最多仅提升了3.5个百分点；而专门为财务领域设计的嵌入模型相比BM25模型仍落后9.7个百分点；当用手工整理的“硬否定”示例替换随机生成的否定示例时，系统的准确率会下降13.0%至20.5%...。

papers.title: Revealed Default Under Choice Overload
papers.abstract: Empirical and experimental studies suggest that a decision maker frequently remains with their default option when making choices even when more preferred alternatives are available, yet standard choice data may not record which option is the default. Existing default-based models often assume that the default option is observed. In contrast, I study a decision maker subject to status quo bias and choice overload and illustrate how one can identify both the decision maker's default and preference from the observed behavior. This paper shows that anomalous choice behavior may arise from a latent default, a possibility largely overlooked in studies of standard choice data.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】实证和实验研究表明，决策者在做选择时往往会坚持使用他们的默认选项，即使有更受欢迎的替代方案可供选择。然而，标准的选择数据可能无法记录哪个选项是默认选项。现有的基于默认选项的模型通常假设默认选项是被观察到的。相比之下，我研究了受到现状偏见（status quo bias）和选择过载（choice overload）影响的决策者，并展示了如何从观察到的行为中识别出决策者的默认选项和偏好。本文指出，异常的选择行为可能源于一个潜在的默认选项，而在标准选择数据的研究中这一可能性往往被忽视。。研究方法：实验方法。

papers.title: Reading Copom's Tone: A Weighted LLM Framework for Hawkish-Dovish Sentiment, Forward Guidance, and Uncertainty
papers.abstract: This paper documents an applied natural-language-processing framework for measuring the tone of Brazilian Monetary Policy Committee (Copom) statements. The project is explicitly inspired by iSent, Itaú's Central Bank sentiment classifier, particularly its sentence-level division of official communication into hawkish, dovish, neutral, and out-of-context classes. The implementation extends that idea in three directions. First, an LLM identifies short hawkish and dovish expressions and assigns each a 0-to-1 intensity weight. Second, the document index combines sentence counts with document-specific average signal intensities, producing a bounded score from -1 to 1. Third, a separate full-document layer measures forward-guidance direction, guidance explicitness, uncertainty level, and change in uncertainty. The empirical sample is restricted to communications dated August 2016 or later and contains 80 statements and 1,498 classified sentences from August 31, 2016 through August 5, 2026. Across this sample, 33.3% of sentences are hawkish, 18.0% dovish, 42.1% neutral, and 6.5% out of context. The average document score is +0.107, while the most hawkish reading is +0.570 in August 2021. The latest statement, dated August 5, 2026, scores +0.232, with eight hawkish, two dovish, and nine neutral sentences. Its structural overlay is more nuanced: guidance is directionally ambiguous but partly explicit, while uncertainty is classified as central and higher than at the prior meeting. Tone and the guidance-direction score have a contemporaneous Pearson correlation of 0.719. These are descriptive outputs, not a validated forecast of Selic decisions or DI returns. The main contribution is therefore methodological: a transparent, incremental, auditable system that separates rhetorical tone from policy guidance and uncertainty.
papers.summary_zh: 【行为金融】本文介绍了一个应用于自然语言处理的框架，用于分析巴西货币政策委员会（Copom）声明的语气。该项目的设计灵感来源于Itaú银行开发的 sentiment 分类器 iSent，尤其是其将官方声明按句子级别划分为“鹰派”、“鸽派”、“中立”和“脱离语境”四类的方法。该框架在三个方面对这一方法进行了扩展：首先，利用大型语言模型（LLM）识别出具有鹰派或鸽派倾向的表述，并为每种倾向分配 0 到 1 的强度权重；其次，通过结合句子出现频率与文档特定的信号强度，生成一个介于 -1 到 1 之间的得分；最后，通过分析整个文档的内容，进一步评估政策指导的方向、明确性、不确定性水平以及不确定性的变化。研究样本仅限于 2016 年 8 月及以后的声明，共包含 80 条声明和 1,498 句被分类的句子（时间范围为 2016 年 8 月 31 日至 2026 年 8 月 5 日）。在这些声明中，33.3% 的句子属于鹰派倾向，18.0% 属于鸽派倾向，42.1% 为中性表述，6.5% 被归类为“脱离语境”。文档的平均得分为 +0.107，其中 2021 年 8 月的声明最具鹰派倾向（得分为 +0.57...。

papers.title: Measuring Concept Content in Text from LLM Activations: ESG Evidence from Concept Vectors and Linear Probes
papers.abstract: Existing measures of how much a text is about a concept read the surface of the text: dictionary word shares, topic proportions, embedding similarities. They score the words a text uses, not the judgment a reader forms about it. Recent work has shown that a gap exists in what Large Language Models (LLMs) know internally versus what they express in their response. This paper asks whether that internal knowledge, read by monitoring the activations of frozen, out-of-the-box LLMs, can stand in for task-specific fine-tuning when measuring concept content, and which extraction method reads it best. We extract such measures via the Recursive Feature Machine (RFM) algorithm and via linear probing, and compare these against an embedding baseline, surface baselines, and the same model's own answer to the question. We demonstrate the approach on financial text, a domain studied extensively and served by established annotated resources, using a human-annotated Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) dataset. The best linear probe comes within 0.6 percentage points of a fine-tuned domain classifier's accuracy without any task-specific fine-tuning, and outscores the same model's own answer to the question in eleven of twelve comparisons, so the activations carry concept content the response does not report. The simple probe consistently beats the RFM concept vectors, which in turn provide what classification alone does not: a continuous score intended to reflect how strongly a concept is present in a text, whose validation awaits graded labels.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】现有的衡量文本与某一概念相关程度的方法仅停留在文本表面：如词汇共享度、主题占比以及嵌入相似性等。这些方法评估的是文本所使用的词汇，而非读者对文本的实际理解。最新研究表明，大型语言模型（LLMs）内部掌握的知识与其在输出中的表达之间存在差距。本文探讨了通过监测未经微调的LLMs的模型激活状态，是否可以替代特定任务的微调来衡量文本的概念内容，以及哪种提取方法能够最有效地捕捉这种内部知识。我们采用递归特征机（RFM）算法和线性探测方法进行数据提取，并将这些结果与嵌入模型、表面分析方法以及该模型对问题的直接回答进行比较。我们在金融文本领域验证了这一方法，该领域已有大量标注资源可供研究，我们使用了由人工标注的环境、社会与治理（ESG）数据集。实验结果表明，最佳线性探测方法的准确性与经过微调的领域分类器的准确度相差仅0.6个百分点，且在十二项比较中中有十一项的表现优于该模型对问题的直接回答；这说明模型激活状态中蕴含了文本回答所未能体现的概念信息。简单线性探测方法始终优于RFM生成的概念向量，而RFM向量则提供了仅靠分类无法获得的连续性评分——这种评分旨在反映概念在文本中的实际存在强度，其有效...。研究方法：大语言模型。

papers.title: Estimating and Testing Kinks in Panel Data Models
papers.abstract: Many economic and financial relationships may change gradually rather than abruptly. We study panel data models in which the coefficient vector is continuous and piecewise linear in calendar time, with a finite number of unknown kink dates at which its slope changes. We propose a penalised least squares estimator that applies adaptive weighted group penalties to the second differences of the coefficient path, and develop asymptotic theory showing that it recovers both the number and the locations of the kinks with probability approaching one. To our knowledge, this is the first panel framework to estimate an unknown number of common kink dates in a time-varying coefficient path under fixed effects. We establish that endpoint slopes converge at the usual cubic regime-length rate and interior slopes at rates determined by their own and adjacent regime lengths. We also develop a coefficient-by-coefficient extension allowing individual regressors to kink at different dates. Monte Carlo evidence supports the good finite sample properties, and we illustrate the method through an application in macro-finance, specifically the relationship between debt and growth.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】许多经济和金融关系往往是逐渐变化的，而非突然发生剧变的。我们研究了面板数据模型，在这些模型中，系数向量在日历时间上呈连续且分段线性的特征，并存在有限数量的未知拐点日期，这些日期是系数斜率发生变化的节点。我们提出了一种惩罚最小二乘估计方法，该方法对系数路径的二阶差分施加自适应加权惩罚，并发展了相应的渐近理论，证明该方法能够以接近1的概率准确识别出拐点的数量和位置。据我们所知，这是首个在固定效应条件下估计时变系数路径中未知数量拐点日期的面板数据分析框架。我们证明了端点斜率的收敛速度遵循常规的三次方制度长度规律，而内部斜率的收敛速度则取决于其自身及相邻制度的长度。此外，我们还开发了一种逐个系数的扩展方法，允许各个回归量在不同的日期发生拐点变化。蒙特卡洛模拟结果验证了该方法在有限样本下的良好性能，并通过宏观经济金融领域的具体应用（即债务与增长之间的关系）对该方法进行了说明。。研究方法：面板数据、固定效应、蒙特卡洛模拟。

papers.title: Lambda-quantiles under the microscope
papers.abstract: We study Lambda-quantiles, a generalisation of classical quantiles in which the constant probability level $λ\in [0,1]$ is replaced by a functional parameter $Λ\colon \mathbb{R} \to [0,1]$. We consider the general case of non-monotone $Λ$, which arises naturally if closure properties of the class of corresponding Lambda-quantiles with respect to inf-aggregation or with respect to mixtures are required. As preliminary results, we characterise finiteness, constancy, and what we call the attainment property known from classical quantiles. We then consider the problem of reconstructing $Λ$ from the values of $Λ$-quantiles on a suitable family of simple distributions, showing its identifiability under mild assumptions. Next, we substantially refine several results obtained in the literature on weak upper and lower semicontinuity and on the property of convexity of the level sets with respect to mixtures, obtaining in both cases almost complete characterisations without any monotonicity assumption. We then move to the case in which $Λ$ has bounded variation, which enables us to prove a mixture representation result: any such $Λ$-quantile can be rewritten as a Lambda-quantile with an increasing functional parameter, evaluated at a mixture of the original distribution with a fixed reference distribution at a fixed weight, thus reducing the complexity of the parameter from bounded variation to monotone. Finally, we introduce and study the notion of the ordinal covariance group of a risk measure, showing that in the case of a $Λ$-quantile it coincides with the compositional invariance group of $Λ$ and with a certain group of measure-preserving transformations of the signed measure associated with $Λ$.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们研究了Lambda-分位数，这是对传统分位数的一种推广，其中恒定的概率水平$λ\in [0,1]$被一个函数参数$Λ\colon \mathbb{R} \to [0,1]$所替代。我们考虑了$Λ$非单调的一般情况，这种情况在需要研究相应Lambda-分位数关于下确界聚合或混合操作的封闭性质时自然会出现。作为初步结果，我们描述了传统分位数所具有的有限性、恒定性以及我们称之为“可达性”的性质。接着，我们探讨了如何从一组简单分布上的$Λ$-分位数值重构$Λ$的问题，并在温和的假设下证明了其可识别性。随后，我们大幅改进了文献中关于弱上半连续性和下半连续性以及关于水平集相对于混合操作的凸性性质的若干结果，在这两种情况下都获得了几乎完整的描述，而无需任何单调性假设。接下来，我们研究了$Λ$具有有界变化的情况，这使我们能够证明一个混合表示定理：任何这样的$Λ$-分位数都可以重写为一个具有递增函数参数的Lambda-分位数，该参数是在原始分布与一个固定参考分布的混合体上按照固定权重进行评估的，从而将参数的复杂性从有界变化降低到了单调变化。最后，我们引入并研究了风险测度的序数协方差群的概念，发...。

papers.title: Auditing Algorithmic Collusion from Strategy Graphs
papers.abstract: Detecting algorithmic collusion is challenging because regulators often have limited access to firms' algorithms, training data, and market information. We study an intermediate-information regime in which an auditor can query firms' frozen pricing policies and construct the induced strategy graph. Using a complete characterization of Nash equilibria in a repeated pricing game, we identify graph-theoretic features of strategy graphs that are associated with collusive reward-and-punishment schemes, including maximum betweenness, attractor in-degree, and average path length. We then test these metrics on policies learned by decentralized Q-learning and the Q-learning algorithm of Calvano et al. (2020). We find that especially the maximum betweenness and attractor in-degree are strongly correlated with the standard profit-based Collusion Index. Importantly, the proposed metrics rely only on the unlabeled topology of strategy graphs and require neither price histories, demand estimates, nor competitive and monopoly benchmarks. Our results suggest that the structure of frozen pricing policies contains robust signals of collusion among reinforcement learning algorithms and provides a promising basis for auditing algorithmic pricing systems under limited information.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】检测算法层面的共谋行为具有挑战性，因为监管机构通常难以获取企业的算法、训练数据和市场信息。我们研究了一种信息较为有限的监管环境，在这种环境下，审计人员可以查询企业的固定定价策略，并据此构建相应的策略图。通过全面分析重复定价博弈中的纳什均衡特性，我们发现了与共谋性奖励与惩罚机制相关的策略图图论特征，包括最大介数、吸引子入度以及平均路径长度。随后，我们将这些指标应用于分散式Q学习算法以及Calvano等人（2020年）提出的Q学习算法所生成的政策数据中。研究发现，尤其是最大介数和吸引子入度与传统的基于利润的共谋指数之间存在显著相关性。重要的是，所提出的指标仅依赖于策略图的拓扑结构，无需价格历史数据、需求估算，也不依赖于竞争或垄断基准。我们的研究结果表明，固定定价策略的结构能够有效反映强化学习算法之间的共谋行为，并为在信息有限的情况下审计算法定价系统提供了有力的依据。。

papers.title: Certified High-Dimensional Wasserstein Robust Portfolio Optimization
papers.abstract: We develop a certified, scalable approximation for high-dimensional Wasserstein distributionally robust portfolio optimization. For expected-utility maximization under order-one Wasserstein ambiguity, standard duality yields a semi-infinite convex program. For long-only portfolios with box support under the one-norm ground metric, an exact sample-specific vertex reformulation provides an exponential-size computational benchmark. We then majorize the utility by supporting hyperplanes and dualize the support subproblems, obtaining a finite hyperplane--dual formulation over compact polyhedral supports. Under the one-norm ground metric and polyhedral portfolio constraints, this formulation is a polynomial-size linear program. The uniform utility-approximation error bounds both the robust-value error and the near-optimality gap for the original robust problem. Experiments validate the certified approximation and demonstrate monthly 476-asset rebalancing and computational scalability to 1,000 assets.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】我们提出了一种经过验证的、可扩展的近似方法，用于高维Wasserstein分布鲁棒投资组合优化问题。在存在一阶Wasserstein不确定性情况下进行期望效用最大化时，标准对偶方法可转化为一个半无限凸规划问题。对于仅持有长期资产且投资组合支持集满足一范数约束的投资组合，通过特定的样本顶点重构方法可以实现指数级计算效率。随后，我们通过引入支撑超平面来对效用函数进行优化处理，并将相关的子问题转化为对偶问题，从而在紧凑的多面体支持集上得到一个有限形式的线性规划模型。在一范数约束及多面体投资组合限制条件下，该线性规划问题的规模为多项式级别。所提出的均匀效用近似方法能够同时限制原始鲁棒问题的鲁棒值误差和接近最优解的差距。实验验证了该近似方法的有效性，并展示了其在每月对476种资产进行再平衡操作时的可行性，同时证明了该方法在处理包含1000种资产的投资组合时的良好计算扩展性。。研究方法：实验方法、优化方法。

papers.title: Acceptant Expansions of Path-Independent Choice Rules
papers.abstract: A choice rule is $q$-acceptant if it chooses $\min\{q,|X|\}$ alternatives from each set $X$. We show that a path-independent rule of maximum cardinality at most $q$ need not have a $q$-acceptant path-independent expansion, refuting Chambers and Yenmez (2017, Theorem 4). We construct a one-school matching market whose unique stable matching leaves a seat vacant that no path-independent expansion of the school's rule fills. Every path-independent rule satisfying the law of aggregate demand has such an expansion. We characterize the choice rules admitting an acceptant expansion by monotone selections of rejected alternatives.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】如果一个选择规则从每个集合$X$中选择$\min\{q,|X|\}$个备选方案，则称该规则为$q$-可接受的。我们证明了：一个最大基数不超过$q$的、与路径无关的选择规则，并不一定存在一个$q$-可接受的、与路径无关的扩展形式，从而反驳了Chambers和Yenmez（2017年）的定理4。我们构建了一个单校匹配市场，在该市场中，唯一的稳定匹配会留下一个空缺席位，而该校规则的任何与路径无关的扩展形式都无法填补这一空缺。所有满足总需求法则的与路径无关的选择规则都存在这样的扩展形式。我们还通过被拒绝备选方案的单调选择方式，刻画了那些能够被扩展为可接受形式的选择规则的特征。。

papers.title: Linguistic Pattern Based Optimization of Economic and Spatial Uniformity Criteria in Facility Layout Problems
papers.abstract: This paper extends prior work on linguistic pattern based facility layout optimization by enhancing the LP Alinks framework with an explicit spatial uniformity criterion. While earlier studies demonstrated that linguistic patterns can effectively encode expert knowledge and guide agent based layout emergence, their optimization scope remained limited to cost oriented objectives. To address this gap, we introduce the Normalized Coverage Score (NCS), a scale adjusted measure of spatial evenness that complements the classical flow distance economic objective and enables systematic exploration of cost uniformity trade offs. A full factorial experiment comprising 324 conditions evaluates the combined effects of problem size, link density, virtual force scaling, and two families of membership functions on both objectives. Five way and nested three way ANOVAs reveal that structural factors (number of objects and link density) exert a dominant baseline influence on both economic performance and spatial uniformity. However, while economic cost is overwhelmingly governed by these structural characteristics, uniformity is substantially more sensitive to the linguistic pattern parameters, which control the dispersion compaction dynamics of the emerging layouts within the structural constraints. Based on these interactions, we derive a parameter-selection matrix that prescribes settings for cost minimization, uniformity maximization, or balanced compromise. Comparative analyses with Drezner's method, MDS, and non metric MDS demonstrate that the extended LP Alinks framework consistently attains superior uniformity while maintaining competitive economic performance, making it a robust and interpretable decision support tool for early stage facility layout design.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文在基于语言模式的空间设施布局优化研究的基础上进行了拓展，通过为LP Alinks框架引入明确的空间均匀性准则来增强其功能。尽管先前的研究表明语言模式能够有效编码专家知识并指导基于智能体的布局生成过程，但这些研究的优化范围仅限于以成本为导向的目标。为了解决这一局限性，我们提出了标准化覆盖度得分（Normalized Coverage Score, NCS）这一衡量空间均匀性的指标，该指标能够补充传统的基于流距离的经济性评估方法，从而系统地探讨成本均匀性与布局优化之间的权衡关系。我们通过包含324种不同条件的全面实验，评估了问题规模、链接密度、虚拟力调节机制以及两类隶属函数对这两个目标的综合影响。五因素方差分析（five-way ANOVA）和嵌套三因素方差分析（nested three-way ANOVA）的结果表明，结构因素（如物体数量和链接密度）对经济性能和空间均匀性均具有显著的基础性影响。然而，虽然经济成本主要受这些结构特征的控制，但空间均匀性对语言模式参数更为敏感——这些参数决定了在结构约束条件下布局的分布与紧凑性。基于这些交互作用，我们构建了一个参数选择矩阵，用于指导...。研究方法：实验方法、优化方法。

papers.title: Tabular Foundation Models and the Unity of Economic Behaviour
papers.abstract: Economics uses different behavioural models for risk, time, losses, valuation, and social choice. I study a unified choice experiment in which the same decision makers face all these domains. I hide a decision maker's choices in one domain and ask a frozen tabular foundation model to recover them from that decision maker's choices elsewhere and labelled choices by other participants. The foundation model improves on the training-sample median, and the gain disappears when visible choices are shuffled across decision makers. I then estimate one random-utility model over the foundation model's learned representation. This structural model applies the same utility function in every domain, retains most of the foundation model's reduction in prediction error, predicts domains excluded from utility estimation, and reproduces how behavioural measures co-move across people. The resulting model separates three objects: a learned common choice domain, one systematic utility function on that domain, and one random component that generates stochastic choice on observed menus.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】经济学采用了多种行为模型来研究风险、时间、损失、估值和社会选择等问题。我设计了一个统一的实验框架，在该框架中，相同的决策者需要面对所有这些决策领域。我隐藏了某决策者在某一特定领域的选择信息，然后利用一个预先设定的基础模型（即“固定表格基础模型”）来根据该决策者在其他领域的选择以及其他参与者的标注信息来推断出其真实选择。这种基础模型在预测准确性上优于基于训练样本计算出的中位数；当这些可见的选择信息在不同决策者之间随机分配时，模型的预测效果会下降。随后，我在该基础模型所学习到的表示基础上构建了一个随机效用模型。这个随机效用模型在所有决策领域中都应用相同的效用函数，同时保留了基础模型在减少预测误差方面的优势，并能够预测那些未被纳入效用估计范围的决策领域。此外，该模型还能准确反映不同个体在行为决策上的共变特征。最终得到的模型包含三个核心组成部分：一个被学习到的通用决策领域、适用于该领域的系统性效用函数，以及一个用于生成随机选择的随机因素。。研究方法：结构模型、实验方法、随机过程。

papers.title: Auction Design with a Bit of Information
papers.abstract: Consider a revenue-maximizing seller who can access a binary signal about two bidders` joint values. We explore what kind of information is most valuable to the seller by studying three classes of signals, each capturing a distinct dimension of bidders` values: their overall level (demand), their relative strength (ranking), and their dispersion while preserving bidder anonymity (competitiveness). We characterize the optimal signal and corresponding auction mechanism within each class, and find that competitiveness signals are particularly effective. Under certain regularity conditions, the optimal competitiveness signal yields at least as much revenue as any ranking signal or demand signal. Moreover, for signals that induce a monotone allocation, the optimal competitiveness signal yields at least as much revenue as any other binary signal.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】考虑一个以收入最大化为目标的卖家，该卖家能够获取关于两名投标者联合价值的二元信号。我们通过研究三类信号来探讨哪种信息对卖家来说最具价值，这三类信号分别反映了投标者价值的不同维度：他们的总体水平（需求）、相对实力（排名）以及在保持投标者匿名性（竞争性）的同时体现出的价值分散程度。我们描述了每类信号下的最优信号及其对应的拍卖机制，并发现竞争性信号尤其有效。在某些规则条件下，最优的竞争性信号所带来的收入至少与任何排名信号或需求信号相当。此外，对于那些能够导致单调分配的信号而言，最优的竞争性信号所带来的收入也至少与其他任何二元信号相当。。
